facts.text: Old Quill leaves the last lantern burning to mark a safe place to talk.

cards.title: Reveal what you know
cards.text: I know this: {knowing} Stand with me when the camp falls quiet.
cards.reply: Keep your voice down. I will hear you out.

cards.title: Bargain with it
cards.text: I can keep this close: {knowing} Let us find some common ground.
cards.reply: A careful word is better than a careless promise.

cards.title: Keep it and ask a question
cards.text: I have heard this: {knowing} What else should I understand?
cards.reply: There is more to a person than the camp sees.

replies.refuse: I have nothing to say about that.
replies.shift_trust_small: I hear you. Let us leave it there for now.
replies.shift_trust_large: Perhaps we can speak plainly with each other.
replies.flip_next_intent: Keep your voice down. I will hear you out.
replies.reveal_fact: There is more to a person than the camp sees.
replies.failed: I am not ready to put my faith in that.
